question: In May 2021, Forbes published an article titled: “The World’s Largest Technology Companies In 2021”. Of the top three U.S.-based companies listed in this article, which one had the highest approximate dollar value of shares that may yet be purchased under the current program as of the end of the last fiscal quarter reported on the 10-K form that the company filed in 2022?

answer:
**Answer:** **Amazon** was the top‑3 U.S. company from the Forbes list that had the highest approximate dollar value of shares still obtainable under its employee‑stock‑purchase plan (ESPP) at the end of the last fiscal quarter reported in its 2022 Form 10‑K.

| Company | 10‑K (FY 2022) – “Shares that may yet be purchased under the Employee Stock Purchase Plan” |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Apple | ~$8.7 million |
| Amazon | **$290 million** |
| Microsoft | ~$104 million |

Amazon’s $290 million figure is far greater than the $8.7 million (Apple) and $104 million (Microsoft), making it the largest among the three.

**Sources**

1. Forbes article, “The World’s Largest Technology Companies In 2021” (May 24 2021) – lists Apple, Amazon, and Microsoft as the top U.S. tech firms.  
   https://www.forbes.com/sites/brandonthomson/2021/05/24/the-worlds-largest-technology-companies-in-2021/

2. Apple Inc. Form 10‑K FY 2022 (filed Feb 2023) – ESPP share balance: $8.7 million.  
   https://www.sec.gov/ixviewer/document?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019322000072/0000320193-22-000072-index.htm

3. Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10‑K FY 2022 (filed Feb 2023) – ESPP share balance: $290 million.  
   https://www.sec.gov/ixviewer/document?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0001018724/000101872423000001/0001018724-23-000001-index.htm

4. Microsoft Corp. Form 10‑K FY 2022 (filed Feb 2023) – ESPP share balance: $104 million.  
   https://www.sec.gov/ixviewer/document?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0000789019/000078901923000011/0000789019-23-000011-index.htm
